## Selected work

- Treasury Router: governed AI financial-advisor workflow and x402 merchant proof-of-flow. Working prototype with deterministic development data; no autonomous execution or live client funds.
- GridSynapse: buyer-side AI compute procurement workflow using public pricing and carbon inputs with deterministic optimization. Modeled capacity, latency, and availability; no provider reservation or spend.
- Orelis: inbound voice-agent product for service-business qualification and human handoff. Production telephony and CRM behavior depend on final implementation.
- Monarch Doctor: open-source build-time preflight for supported x402 payment-code patterns. It is not runtime payment enforcement, fraud prevention, or compliance software.
